completedCapabilities: Fresh installations consistently default to MySQL schema CCMA and application user ccma; Compose uses an authenticated database healthcheck, manual unique-index migration is restart-idempotent, and external pricing synchronization is opt-in.

S0 has a versioned synthetic Vietnamese intervention corpus and an empty-development-database baseline; the first S1 slice reports item-level sync failures as partial without advancing the success checkpoint or triggering after-sync analysis.

S1 analysis snapshots: core single/batch snapshot and evidence validation plus cascade/fingerprint and parent-locking repairs are implemented. ResetDemoData now uses an error-checked transaction; snapshot-bound MySQL regressions prove rollback preservation and success-path deletion. Independent Gate B REVIEW passed at commit 20cfa55, but FREEZE remains open. The optional legacy demo fixture branch is not exercised by the current reset tests; engine tests cover legacy result interpretation. Test-double/MySQL evidence is not real-provider governance proof.

CCMAI-RUNTIME-003 REVIEW PASS: a same-external-ID message replay updates changed content/sender/content-type/timestamp and merges attachments by (type, url, name) identity, preserving a stored local path only for a matching identity and never erasing a stored attachment list from an empty reply. Repair round 1 (R003-R1/R003-R2) added raw-data serialization with error checks (an unmarshalable value now returns an error instead of staying silently stale) and canonical-JSON comparison so an unchanged raw-data replay issues no write; the central replay test now also changes and asserts sender role and content type. Codex independently re-reviewed commit 1f290a6 and reran all 8 replay tests and the full backend suite on disposable MySQL CCMA. S1 remains IN_PROGRESS; FREEZE remains open.

CCMAI-RUNTIME-004 repair rounds 1 and 2: linked snapshot digest/provenance validation, added-earlier-message count detection, and real ExportResults CSV/XLSX changed/unchanged and query-failure tests passed independent REVIEW. Focused tests and all 13 backend packages pass on disposable MySQL; Codex independently reran the focused endpoint tests. Status REVIEW_PASS / FREEZE_OPEN; S1 remains IN_PROGRESS. No real-channel or provider proof.

CCMAI-RUNTIME-005 REVIEW PASS / FREEZE OPEN: job results no longer carry fabricated confidence. New QC evaluations/violations, classification evaluations and all demo rows store confidence NULL with basis unavailable. Classification tags keep only the validated model number labeled model_reported_uncalibrated. Legacy rows keep their stored numbers with a NULL basis and serialize as null/unavailable, and a Save cannot rewrite them. Both job-result endpoints return confidence number|null plus confidence_basis. Notifications show no bare percentage, only a labeled uncalibrated model estimate. Migration was checked twice on fresh and pre-existing tables with legacy rows preserved; rolling back shows NULL as 0 under the old binary. All 13 backend packages and the frontend build pass; Codex independently reran focused tests on disposable MySQL. No calibration or live governance claim.

CCMAI-RUNTIME-006 BUILD / REVIEW_PENDING: job-specific result endpoints (ListJobResults, ListAllJobResults) and the QC/classification CSV/XLSX job exports now carry R004 local source_integrity_status through one shared, chunked, tenant-scoped evaluator, which the aggregate Results page also reuses unchanged. Exports show every distinct status in a grouped conversation, most concerning first, plus per-result traceability, and label the classification chat text as read at export time. Query errors fail with a JSON 500 before any file bytes. Job Detail shows the statuses in both tables, both card headers and the dialog, with the local-only caveat. R005 confidence fields are unchanged. All 13 backend packages, focused endpoint/export/failure tests, vitest and the frontend build pass. No upstream-completeness or live governance claim.
